verdict.rationale: MotherDuck Flights is a first-party feature for Python jobs that run on a recurring schedule inside MotherDuck. The platform handles runtime, scheduling, secrets, logging and versioning, and the jobs can be built by an agent, so they run autonomously in the background rather than as one-off actions. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on schedule configuration, triggers, and failure handling or alerting; independent or hands-on corroboration of Flights.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Run Python jobs on a schedule for ingest, transformation, and operational tasks
